newsitem.title: USA: Gas-like odor forces evacuations in St. Louis.
newsitem.headline: Gas-like odor forces evacuations in St. Louis.

text.p: A natural gas-like odour reported across a wide area of downtown St. Louis forced the evacuation of an office building and part of a school Monday, officials said.

About 1,200 workers at a Blue Cross building were sent home after some of them complained of nausea. Twenty-nine people were treated at the scene and a few were sent to hospitals. None of the injuries was said to be serious.
A child development centre at a high school was also evacuated.
The fire department said the source of the complaints appeared to be an artificial odour added to natural gas so it can be detected. It was not known how the odour was released into the air.
Fire officials said they had received about 60 calls complaining about the smell from across the downtown area.
